This LIMITED WAIVER AND THIRD AMENDMENT (this “ Agreement”) is entered into as

                                   RECITALS                                    
A.The Borrower, the Investment Manager, the Agents, the lenders party thereto
from time to time (the “ Lenders”) and the Structuring Advisor are parties to
that certain Credit and Security Agreement, dated as of July 18, 2024 (as has

modified from time to time, the “ Credit Agreement”), pursuant to which, among
other things, the Lenders agreed, subject to the terms and conditions set forth

accommodations to the Borrower.

and the Agents (at the direction of the Lenders) desire
…
tracts governing the relationship between such parties with

Borrower/Lender Documents may be modified or amended, nor may any rights

any condition in, or breach of, any of the foregoing in a particular instance
shall not operate as a waiver of other or subsequent conditions or breaches of

exercise any rights or remedies under any of the foregoing in a particular
instance shall not operate as a waiver of its right to exercise the same or
different rights and remedies in any other instances. There are no oral
agreements among the parties hereto.

the Agents to execute and deliver this Agreement.
